name: fmp_available_sectors
description:
Sector names FMP uses to classify companies, from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/available-sectors as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Use the values as the sector filter of fmp_stock_screener; sector moves: fmp_sector_performance.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
